title: Monster Tracks
description: Drive powerful monster trucks over crazy obstacle courses requiring delicate throttle control and physical balancing.
author: Pizza Edition
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to accelerate, brake, and lean.

title: Polytrack
description: High-speed low-poly racing game where you zoom through challenging tracks and construct custom stunt circuits.
author: Pizza Edition
controls: WASD or Arrow keys to steer, Spacebar to brake, R to restart level.

title: Basketball Stars
description: Compete in fast-paced 1v1 or 2v2 basketball matches with famous character heads, mega dunks, and special abilities.
author: MadPuffers
controls: 1P: WASD to move/jump, X for super shot, Z for dash. 2P: Arrow keys to move, K for super shot, L for dash.

title: Basket Random
description: Hysterical physics-based basketball game featuring one-button controls, wacky bouncing ragdolls, and changing courts.
author: RHM Interactive
controls: Player 1: W key | Player 2: UP Arrow key. Hold to jump, bounce, and shoot!

title: Dune
description: Glide smoothly over golden desert dunes, soar past the high line into space, and stick clean landings to score big.
author: Voodoo
controls: Click & hold Left Mouse Button or Spacebar to dive and accelerate down dune slopes.

title: Monkey Mart
description: Run your own lively supermarket as an ambitious monkey! Harvest crops, stock fresh goods, hire workers, and expand.
author: TinyDobbins
controls: WASD or Arrow keys to move your monkey around the market.
